name: notify_hr_compliance
description: notify_hr_compliance: Notify HR compliance that an I-9 verification has been completed.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP072948

case_id.description: The I-9 case ID. Format: CASE-I9-6digits. Example: CASE-I9-072948

notification_type.description: The verification type completed: i9_verified (for initial verification) or i9_reverified (for reverification)
